parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: `1`.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter condition in the `{"key":"value"}`format. You must specify the `key` and `value` of the filter condition.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: `10`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-activated-alerts --filter 'alertname_:_容器CPU使用率大于80%' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListActivatedAlerts --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --Filter 'alertname_:_容器CPU使用率大于80%' --CurrentPage 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
